LanguageData.MST.MaxRangedDPSComment: The maximum DPS of a ranged weapon. Results may deviate for weapons with special mechanics.
LanguageData.MST.AverageRangedDPSComment: The expected DPS of a ranged weapon firing at its optimal accuracy range. Results may deviate for weapons with special mechanics.
LanguageData.MST.LMeleeDPSComment: The expected DPS of a legendary quality melee weapon. If unaffected by quality, the value is the same as non-quality.
LanguageData.MST.LRangedDPSComment: The expected DPS of a legendary quality ranged weapon firing at its optimal accuracy range. If unaffected by quality, the value is the same as non-quality.
LanguageData.MST.ticksBetweenBurstShotsComment: The interval between each shot after aiming, in ticks (1/60 second), e.g., 30 ticks is 0.5 seconds.
LanguageData.MST.OptimalRangeComment: The distance at which a ranged weapon has the highest accuracy. Results may deviate for weapons with special mechanics.
LanguageData.MST.explosionRadiusComment: The radius of the explosion. The editor does not support adding explosion effects; it will only modify existing ones.
LanguageData.MST.fuelMultiplierComment: The multiplier for fuel consumption. The editor will only modify existing fuel properties.
LanguageData.MST.fuelConsumptionRateComment: The multiplier for fuel depletion over time. The value is meaningless if fuel does not deplete over time. The editor will only modify existing fuel properties.
LanguageData.MST.projectileSpeedComment: The flight speed of the projectile on the map.
LanguageData.MST.damageAmountBaseComment: The base damage dealt. If -1, it means the damage value is solely determined by the damage type's default damage.
LanguageData.MST.armorPenetrationBaseComment: The armor penetration of the damage. If -1, it means the armor penetration is 15% of the damage, e.g., 10 damage corresponds to 15% armor penetration.
LanguageData.MST.allowInMechClustersComment: Whether it is allowed to appear in mechanoid clusters.
LanguageData.MST.collidesWithPawnsComment: Whether pawns are prevented from sharing the same tile.
LanguageData.MST.canOpenAnyDoorComment: Whether the pawn can open any door regardless of restrictions.
LanguageData.MST.stuffCategoriesComment: Which categories of materials can be used to craft this item. Affects available materials when selecting Bills.
LanguageData.MST.researchPrerequisitesComment: Research projects required to unlock this item's construction.
LanguageData.MST.statBasesComment: Directly modify the weapon's base stat values (e.g., market value, max hit points).
LanguageData.MST.equippedStatOffsetsComment: Offset bonuses to pawn stats when this weapon is equipped.
LanguageData.MST.removeReloadableCompComment: Enable to remove the reloadable component. This component cannot be added via this editor.
LanguageData.MST.reloadableAmmoCountToRefillComment: Fixed amount of ammo consumed to fully refill all charges. Set this OR ammoCountPerCharge, not both.
LanguageData.MST.reloadableAmmoCountPerChargeComment: Ammo consumed per charge restored. Set this OR ammoCountToRefill, not both.
LanguageData.MST.reloadableBaseReloadTicksComment: Base reload time in ticks (1/60 sec). Also used as the cooldown duration when replenishAfterCooldown is enabled.
LanguageData.MST.reloadableReplenishAfterCooldownComm: If enabled, charges automatically replenish after a cooldown instead of requiring manual reload.
LanguageData.MST.reloadableMaxChargesComment: Maximum number of charges this weapon can hold.
